verdict.rationale: Adyen documents balance accounts with either pooled or per-card balances, and webhooks that report when merchants initiate payments and when funds are added to or deducted from balance accounts. It also documents Transfer and Report webhook types and viewing card payments in the Customer Area. This covers real-time balance and money-movement visibility, but nothing shows a ledger that links each authorization to its clearing, or settlement reports that reconcile. missing for 10: documented authorization-to-clearing ledger linkage, settlement and reconciliation report contents, real-time balance query/API detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.
